theme.title: Crowds, ratings and parades
theme.subtitle: Who was watching
theme.recap: From 4,000 people in Hershey to 108,713 in Texas, the NBA's audience numbers swing wildly.

questions.prompt: The 2010 NBA All-Star Game set the attendance record for a basketball game. How many people were there?
questions.context: 2010 NBA All-Star Game · held in a football stadium

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In 2010, the NBA All-Star Game set the attendance record for a basketball game with 108,713 people

funFacts.text: The All-Star spectacle took place in Cowboys Stadium rather than the Dallas Mavericks' basketball arena.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The venue for the game on February 14 was Cowboys Stadium

funFacts.text: The pregame festivities and Saturday contests were staged at a separate venue, American Airlines Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: NBA All-Star Saturday Night events were held on February 12 and February 13, 2010

funFacts.text: For the first time, neither All-Star team wore white: the East donned blue, while the West wore red.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This marked the first All-Star game where neither team wore a white uniform

questions.prompt: How many points did the East score in the 2024 All-Star Game?
questions.context: 2024 NBA All-Star Game · East vs West

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: East 211 – 186 West

funFacts.text: The league restored the traditional East-versus-West format after years of captains drafting teams.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the return of the Eastern Conference versus Western Conference format

funFacts.text: Damian Lillard earned the All-Star MVP award during the high-scoring Indianapolis spectacle.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: MVP  | Damian Lillard (East)

funFacts.text: The game used Gainbridge Fieldhouse, while Lucas Oil Stadium hosted Saturday night's contests.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gainbridge Fieldhouse (All-Star Game)

questions.prompt: How many fans attended the first NBA All-Star Game in 1951?
questions.note: 10,094, when the average crowd was about 3,500.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: drawing an attendance of 10,094, much higher than that season's average attendance of 3,500.

funFacts.text: The first All-Star Game came out of a public-relations push following a college basketball point-shaving scandal.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the basketball world had just been rocked by the college basketball point-shaving scandal

funFacts.text: Celtics owner Walter Brown offered to host the event and cover any losses himself.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Brown remained confident that it would be a success. He even offered to host the game

funFacts.text: The original All-Stars were chosen by sportswriters who were not allowed to vote for players from their own cities.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They were not allowed to select players from their own cities

questions.prompt: The 2007 Finals sweep set what was then a record-low TV rating. What was it?
questions.context: 2007 NBA Finals · Spurs vs Cavaliers · ABC

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: San Antonio's four-game sweep of Cleveland finished with a record-low 6.2 television rating and 11 share on ABC

funFacts.text: Cleveland was appearing in its first NBA Finals, as was its young superstar LeBron James.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was Cleveland's first trip to the NBA Finals in their franchise history

funFacts.text: San Antonio guard Tony Parker earned Finals MVP after the Spurs swept Cleveland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tony Parker was named the series' MVP

funFacts.text: The 2007 championship series was the last four-game Finals sweep until 2018, also featuring Cleveland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This series was the last sweep in the NBA Finals until 2018

questions.prompt: About how many million people attended Cleveland's 2016 title parade?
questions.note: An estimated 1.3 million, then the largest NBA parade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: An estimated 1.3 million people attended the, then-largest, NBA championship parade in history.

funFacts.text: Cleveland Browns legend and civil-rights advocate Jim Brown attended the Cavaliers' championship celebration.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Cleveland Browns Hall of Fame running back and Civil Rights activist Jim Brown attended the parade

funFacts.text: Cavaliers announcer Fred McLeod likened the moment to Jim Brown passing Cleveland's sporting torch to LeBron.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Fred McLeod narrated the scene to the crowd

funFacts.text: After Golden State's loss, Draymond Green called the front office to press for Kevin Durant's signing.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: made a phone call to general manager Bob Myers to urge him to try and sign
